review_comments.body:
Guard against someone changing the default port (requires `config` to be passed alongside `pkgs, lib, ...`)

```suggestion
        kumaUrl = "http://${config.services.uptime-kuma.settings.HOST}:${config.services.uptime-kuma.settings.PORT}";
```

or maybe

```suggestion
        kumaUrl = with config.services.uptime-kuma.settings; "http://${HOST}:${PORT}";
```

Applies to many other sections of the test as well.

Another alternative would be to set `host` and `port` in a top-level `let` binding and then pass them also to `services.uptime-kuma.settings`. That way you wouldn't have to refer to `config.services.uptime-kuma.settings` all the time.

This probably needs proper escaping and `kumaUser` and `kumaPassword` need to be in scope.
```suggestion
    machine.succeed("echo \"insert into user (username, password) values ('${kumaUser}', '$(mkpasswd -m bcrypt "${kumaPassword}")');\" | sqlite3 /var/lib/uptime-kuma/kuma.db");
```
Maybe there is even a Nix function that can do bcrypt on a string, so you don't have to use the shell. Otherwise you could maybe do it in Python inside `testScript`. Unfortunately, I can't tell you exactly which packages are available.
Nice trick! 👍

reviews.body: Do you think you could create a NixOS test for this?
[IA a test would be good for future maintainability](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/509610#pullrequestreview-4139339474)
Mostly just some leftover hardcoded constants.

It would be good to add modular services support, however this requires extensive work to do, so best done in a follow up by someone experienced. LGTM

And also needs a squash for the `nixos/autokuma` commits before merge.
LGTM, though the merge commit should definetly in the history

I suggest adding stricter typing (or at least better docs), for example in my module: https://git.bartoostveen.nl/bart/infra/src/commit/d0552d5e6b5bdd4b9dcc9e6a43bd7e8add76af18/modules/infra/autokuma.nix#L51 and https://git.bartoostveen.nl/bart/infra/src/commit/d0552d5e6b5bdd4b9dcc9e6a43bd7e8add76af18/modules/infra/autokuma.nix#L295 (this module is a bit messy as it evolved, but the option types are pretty clear I think). We should still allow allow other attributes to be set, as the module might not keep up with the configuration scheme changes upstream, but we should at least provide proper guidance, let alone the fact that seeing the activity on Autokuma there might not be any significant configuration scheme changes.

We might want to document how to pass a password through a non-world-readable file as well, as the `password` option does not provide context on how to do that, see: https://git.bartoostveen.nl/bart/infra/src/commit/d0552d5e6b5bdd4b9dcc9e6a43bd7e8add76af18/modules/infra/autokuma.nix#L136.

If I can be of any help here, please let me know, I'd be glad to maintain this module as well.
Generally going in the right direction, some general remarks. Also, make sure to reword your last commit. See https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
